top_reviews.title: Christmas gift
top_reviews.text:
Product looks like the pictures. I bought them for my granddaughters with their approval of the style and color they wanted. They won't be disappointed. I bought the beige and a few days later bought the black. Stuck my foot inside and the fur feels so warm and cozy. Very nice quality. I wish they came in a midnight red. Very fashionable, no regrets but I will have to update after the girls put them through the true test in the winter months to come.
Now that I have Christmas out the way, my granddaughter's received their gifts and loved them I'll now order my own!
